title: Normalized source coordinates for affine conormal base change
statement: Let i:Z→X and i':Z'→X' be closed immersions of schemes [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] in a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product] with maps g:X→X' and f:Z→Z' and equality i≫g=f≫i'. Fix affine ambient opens U and U' with U contained in g inverse image U'. Put A=Gamma(X',U'), B=Gamma(X,U), J=i'.ker.ideal U', and S=f*(i'*i'.ker), with module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. There exists an additive equivalence eS from Gamma(S,i inverse image U) to B tensor_A J.Cotangent. For every b in B, a in J and ideal section s' over U' representing a, the inverse eS sends b tensor class(a) to i.app(U)(b) times the restriction of the successive adjunction units of s'. The successive-unit section is transported from (f≫i') inverse image U' to (i≫g) inverse image U' by pushforwardComp and pushforwardCongr of the square equality. This statement constructs only the source coordinates, and asserts no property of a conormal morphism or target coordinate.

source.place: Tag 0473, affine reduction; Tag 01R3 (2); Stacks Project Schemes Tag 01JU (1). Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0473, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01R3 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01JU.

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-conormal-affine-tensor-coordinates] to obtain the normalized additive equivalence e from B tensor_A J.Cotangent to the tensor of conormal sections over C with D. The inverse-image opens V and V' are affine; h gives their inclusion V⊆f⁻¹V'.

The conormal T=(tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules is quasi-coherent by affine_conormal_sections. Apply exists_tensorPullback_affine_sections to f,V',V and the inclusion. Turn the bijective comparison c T into an additive equivalence d. Set eS=(e.trans d).symm. Its inverse on b tensor class(a) is computed by the normalization of e and the pure-tensor formula for c.

Expand Hom.comp_app, pushforward_map_app, pushforwardComp_hom_app_app, pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app and concrete composition. The successive-unit section on the right is the same section as in the affine comparison, followed by equality transport. PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply combines equality transport with restriction; uniqueness of arrows in the opposite category of opens identifies the composite with homOfLE K. This proves the normalization.

theorem closedImmersion_conormal_affine_source_coordinates
    {X Z X' Z' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (i' : Z' ⟶ X')
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (g : X ⟶ X') (f : Z ⟶ Z') (h : i ≫ g = f ≫ i')
    (hc : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk i f h))
    (U : X.affineOpens) (U' : X'.affineOpens) (H : U.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(X', U'.1) Γ(X, U.1) := (g.appLE U'.1 U.1 H).hom.toAlgebra
    let S := (tensorPullback f).obj ((tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules)
    ∃ eS : Γ(S, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≃+ Γ(X, U.1) ⊗[Γ(X', U'.1)]
        (i'.ker.ideal U').Cotangent,
      (∀ (b : Γ(X, U.1)) (a : i'.ker.ideal U') (s' : Γ(i'.ker.toModules, U'.1)),
        i'.ker.toModulesι.app U'.1 s' = (a : Γ(X', U'.1)) →
        eS.symm (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(X', U'.1)] (i'.ker.ideal U').toCotangent a) =
          i.app U.1 b • S.val.map (homOfLE (i.preimage_mono H)).op
            ((((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i')).unit.app
                i'.ker.toModules) ≫
              (pushforward i').map
                (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)).unit.app
                  ((tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules))) ≫
              (pushforwardComp f i').hom.app S ≫
              (pushforwardCongr h.symm).hom.app S).app U'.1 s'))
